title: Which Egg Hides the Dragon?
youtube_description:
Can YOU guess which egg has the dragon inside? Watch to find out! 🐉🔥 Come back tomorrow for Level 2!

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Dragon #Eggs #Kidify #FunForKids #PuzzleForKids

scenes.narration: One of these eggs hides a DRAGON — but which one?!
We've got the red egg, the blue egg, and the golden egg. Choose fast!
Three… two… one — let's crack them open!
The red egg… it's just a rubber duck! Quack quack, no dragon here!
The blue egg… oh wow, it's a tiny little frog! So cute, but still no dragon!
The GOLDEN egg — crack it open and… YES! There's the dragon! You found it!
Did you guess right? Level 2 is coming tomorrow — don't miss it!
